en: {rival}
Oh! Nice! You've come here to toughen up too, huh?
Right, then let's see how much stronger you've got! Come on!
Not bad... You think about how to bring out your Pokémon's strength. I've got to step it up.
{player} handed over the Town Map!
Tch... she didn't have to do that. But thanks. We've barely set out and you're already helping me.
I thought I heard a commotion! A Pokémon battle, was it? Ah, to be young!
{rival}
Who are you?
Owner
Who am I? Why, I own this ranch! And this is my wife.
Wife
You should always heal your Pokémon after a battle. Here, take one of these, both of you.
Potions are good to have when you're far from a Pokémon Center.
Owner
Say, you didn't see a Herdier anywhere about, did you? It's wandered off, and I can't think where.
I'm a little worried, to tell the truth.
{rival}
A LITTLE worried? Are you kidding me?! Your Pokémon could be gone forever!
I'll find it myself! {player}, help me look!
Owner
My, what got into him? I'm sure it's just off playing somewhere on the ranch.
Wife
I wonder... Oh, and dear, if your Pokémon get hurt, come and see me. I'll make them feel better.
{rival}
Did the Herdier wander up this way? Let's look!
{rival}
It's not up here either. Oh! Here, I'll share something good with you.
If your Pokémon gets paralysed, use that on it.
Still, Pokémon don't just wander off by themselves. If it's mixed up in some kind of trouble...
{rival}
Did you hear that just now?
I'll check round here. You go deeper into the grove and look!
Herdier
Yaaarp...
{rival}
That cry! You found it! What a relief! I'll go and get its Trainer. You stay here!
Grunt
Tch! You little pest! Do you know who you're dealing with?
We're the group that tried to take over Unova two years ago, to set Pokémon free from people like you!
Not that a kid like you would understand. First I get lost chasing this mutt, and now this...
Fine! I'll take this chance to get out of here!
Something was left lying where the grunt stood.
Owner
Herdier! What were you doing all the way out here? I can't thank you enough, the both of you!
{rival}
You're awfully calm about this! Your Pokémon could have been gone for good! Take better care of it!
Owner
Hmm... I wonder if something happened to that boy. It's as if he's afraid of losing Pokémon...
Come on, Herdier. Let's go home.
{rival}
Where could that Herdier have got to? We have to find it!
Owner
It's strange for Herdier to wander off. It always plays with the other one, or helps out on the ranch.
Thanks to you and your Pokémon, Herdier is home safe! Did Alder train you, by any chance?
Wife
You and your Pokémon look a little worn out. Rest a minute. You won't get far tired like that!
There! You're both full of energy again.
Herdier
Bawoof! Ba-woof!
